title: StockSmart Program-by-Program Measurement of Minimums, Allowances and Entry Gates
content:
Under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program every program stands on its own figures.

1. Each program is measured on its own: the monthly minimum, included bins, included changes, emergency visits and fees apply per program and are never pooled across a customer's programs.
2. Program spend does not count toward the served ship-to's order minimum, free freight threshold or service level spend, and order spend at the ship-to does not count toward the program minimum.
3. A program's tier entry gate is measured on the program's own trailing 12 month program spend and its own bin count.

### What the separation means in practice

| Figure | Measured on |
|---|---|
| Monthly minimum, included bins, included bin adds and par changes, included emergency visits, fees | the one program alone |
| The ship-to's order minimum, free freight threshold, service level spend | the ship-to's orders, never program spend |
| The program minimum | program spend, never the ship-to's order spend |
| A program's tier entry gate | that program's own trailing 12 month program spend and bin count |

### Basis questions

**A customer holds two programs at two ship-tos and one falls short of its monthly minimum. May the other program's spend make up the shortfall?** No. Minimums are never pooled across a customer's programs.

**Does an order placed by the served ship-to count toward the program's monthly minimum?** No. Order spend at the ship-to does not count toward the program minimum, and program spend does not count toward the ship-to's order figures.
